$description: The Links — canonical design tokens. W3C DTCG. This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the brand; src/styles/tokens.css is compiled from it. Derived from the `blue-navy` direction chosen by the client on 2026-08-02 (wisplet rv_TPEdpfhufWV9Me, variant var_m5Ht7Z), then completed: the structural vocabulary the previous canonical file lacked entirely (breakpoints, z-index, motion, control sizing, icon scale, opacity) is filled in here so no surface has to re-invent it. Every text pairing records its measured contrast ratio. Ratios are computed, never estimated.

com.monkeyjumplabs.meta.status: canonical — supersedes the 1.x forest-green set, kept at design/tokens.v1-forest.json.bak
com.monkeyjumplabs.meta.register: softened brutalist — a scoreboard, not a brochure
com.monkeyjumplabs.meta.provenance: design-factory run, rounds 1-2. Decision trail: design/RUN.md. The direction's own reasoning: design/token-sets/blue-navy.md.
com.monkeyjumplabs.meta.contrastPolicy: WCAG 2.1 AA. Body text >= 4.5:1, large text and non-text boundaries >= 3:1. Nothing here relies on the large-text allowance for body copy. Any new pairing must be computed before use.

palette.$description: Raw primitives. Never reference these directly in a component - use semantic.*. The blue ramp is six stops from the room at night to the screen on the wall.

midnight.$description: Stop 1. The structural dark: chrome, hero, jobs band, footer, media-slot ground. white 17.50:1 - paper 16.09:1 - amber 9.48:1 - slate 5.48:1 - screenLight 11.07:1.

navy.$description: Stop 2. Display headings and structural rules on light. on white 13.31:1 - on paper 12.24:1.

navyMid.$description: Stop 3. Body copy and links on light grounds. on white 9.92:1 - on paper 9.13:1 - on greige 7.65:1.

inkMutedCool.$description: Stop 4. Secondary text, captions, table meta on light. on white 6.87:1 - on paper 6.32:1 - on greige 5.29:1.

slate.$description: Stop 5. Muted text on dark grounds. on midnight 5.48:1. Revived deliberately from the retired 1.x palette - its 3.20:1 failure was a LIGHTNESS failure in a text-bearing button role, not a fault of the hue. It is never a fill here.

screenLight.$description: Stop 6, and the point of the whole direction. The simulator projection. on midnight 11.07:1. Fills the gap the 1.x palette could not: it had no bright cool value, so 'a warm dark room with one bright screen' was inexpressible (old screen measured 1.81:1 on the dark ground).

forest.$description: RETAINED AS A VALUE, DEMOTED AS A ROLE. Was the 1.x theme's declared black across 66 sections. It now holds exactly two jobs: the projected fairway inside the simulator screen (6.41:1 against screenLight - green is genuinely what is on the wall in the real building), and state.success (10.14:1 on white). Retreat path if the brand ever wants green back as a ground: repoint semantic.ground.jobs to forest; every ratio reproduces within 0.6.

ember.$description: The action colour, and the full-bleed offer band. on white 7.45:1 - paper on it 6.85:1. Its exact darkness is load-bearing - see emberHover.

emberHover.$description: paper on it 4.91:1. This is the binding constraint on the whole ember family: the codebase applies computed hover brightening, so ember was chosen as the darkest attractive value whose BRIGHTENED form still clears AA. Do not lighten ember without recomputing this.

emberMid.$description: Caution / warning. on white 4.76:1 (AA text). CONSTRAINT: only 3.66:1 on greige - never set warning text on the greige field.

amber.$description: The pendant light, and the CTA fill on dark grounds. on midnight 9.48:1. FORBIDDEN on light: 1.85:1 on white.

emberTint.$description: Warm light field. Held for future surfaces; not used on the homepage.

paper.$description: Body copy on dark, and the slab punched out of the ember band. on midnight 16.09:1.

white.$description: The light ground and maximum-contrast text on dark. on midnight 17.50:1.

greige.$description: Alternating light field and the disabled surface.

clay.$description: Error and destructive only. on white 7.19:1 - on paper 6.61:1.

disabledInk.$description: Disabled label. on greige 4.74:1 - on white 6.15:1. REPLACES the 1.x green-grey #52685B, a leftover from the forest palette that did not belong in a cool system. Chosen to sit visibly lighter than inkMutedCool so disabled and merely-secondary text do not read alike.

retired.$description: Kept for provenance and migration only. Never reference.

screen.$description: 1.x informational blue. Only 1.81:1 on the dark ground - the reason the palette could not draw its own brief. Superseded by screenLight.

moss.$description: 1.x success green. Redundant now that forest holds success.

slateAsButton.$description: The 1.x action colour. White on it is 3.20:1 - it failed on every button of all 41 pages of the old site. The VALUE survives as palette.slate for muted text on dark; the ROLE does not.

semantic.$description: What components reference. Every entry names its ground so a ratio is checkable.

chrome.$description: Sticky header and footer. Merges with the hero into one unbroken dark field.

raised.$description: Cards and panels on the light ground.

accentBand.$description: THE one accent field, used once per page at full strength.

rowHover.$description: Row hover on dark - one step UP the ramp rather than a tint.

media.$description: Image-slot ground. Target 33-38% of frame near-black, matching the real shoot.

onDark.$description: Body, nav and footer copy on midnight. 16.09:1.

mutedOnDark.$description: Captions and meta on midnight. 5.48:1. Midnight grounds only - 4.16:1 on navy, which misses AA body. When the ground is navy use ink.mutedOnNavy.

mutedOnNavy.$description: Captions, meta and gap marks on a NAVY ground - the row-hover field and the tinted 'Not yet set' cell. 8.42:1. This token exists because nothing previously stopped a designer reaching for mutedOnDark on navy at 4.16:1, and three of four design agents did exactly that. It also gives navy bands a cooler readout tone that distinguishes them from midnight ones.

displayOnLight.$description: Display headings and scoreboard figures on light. 13.31:1 on white.

bodyOnLight.$description: Body copy and links on light. 9.92 / 9.13 / 7.65:1 on white / paper / greige.

mutedOnLight.$description: Captions and sub-rules on light. 6.87 / 6.32 / 5.29:1. NEVER use an opacity of the ink colour for this - ink at 70% computes to 4.39:1 and misses AA.

default.$description: Solid CTA fill on LIGHT grounds only. Label 6.85:1.

on.$description: The label on a primary fill.

onDarkFillInk.$description: The label on the amber CTA.

onDarkFillHover.$description: Hover state of the dark-field CTA.

highlight.$description: Eyebrows, score rules, the reassurance lines. Dark grounds only.

screen.$description: The projection. Dark grounds only - 1.58:1 on white.

onDark.$description: Cell rules on midnight. The grid is meant to be seen.

scoreOnDark.$description: The heavy band separator on dark. 9.48:1.

scoreOnLight.$description: The heavy band separator on light. 7.45:1.

focus.$description: Focus slab on light. 7.45:1 vs white.

info.$description: 9.92:1 on white. DELIBERATE: the system has one cool hue, so informational state is the brand blue rather than a second blue nobody would distinguish from it.

disabledInk.$description: 4.74:1 on the disabled surface. Disabled stays readable.

slotScreen.$description: The one bright screen. 11.07:1 on the slot ground.

slotFairway.$description: The projected course inside the screen. 6.41:1 against slotScreen.

slotMass.$description: The bar mass. 1.31:1 against the slot ground ON PURPOSE - furniture reads as silhouette, not as content.

slotFrame.$description: The rule around the slot. The slot is always visibly a reservation, never a photo.

slotLabel.$description: The caption naming the exact missing frame. 5.48:1.

display.$description: Variable grotesque, weight 100-900 and width 62-125. The width axis makes proportion a second hierarchy tool, and a grotesque page face lets a slab wordmark read as a MARK rather than as the same font set larger. NOT YET SELF-HOSTED - see notes.pendingImplementation.

body.$description: Retained from the 1.x system and already self-hosted. Warmth in the copy, not in the type.

numeric.$description: Scoreboard figures. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums so columns align.

retired.$description: Bitter and Alfa Slab One survive ONLY inside the drawn wordmark. Poppins is deleted outright - the old site loaded it across 41 pages to set a single button.

displayHero.$description: Was clamp(3rem, 10.5vw, 8.25rem) — 132px at 1440px, which read as shouting rather than confident. Down ~36%.

displayRow.$description: Was clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2.125rem). Kept in proportion to the two steps above it.

bodySmall.$description: The floor for anything a user must read.

tapMin.$description: Minimum interactive target. A hard floor on density.

mediaRatio.$description: 3:2 - the aspect the real photography will arrive in.

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, switcher chips. THE ONLY radius on the site. This single value is the whole of the client-requested softening - everything else stays square.

surface.$description: Panels, cells, media slots. Square, explicitly.

badge.$description: Declared so nobody helpfully rounds a tag.

hairline.$description: Cell dividers inside a block - the ledger rules.

ruleQuiet.$description: Secondary internal boundaries. Part of the softening: these were 2px before.

rule.$description: Component boundaries: inputs, media slots, cards.

score.$description: Band separators and the focus slab.

slab.$description: The lead rule above a section heading.

elevation.$description: Depth is expressed by RULES AND GROUND INVERSION, never by shadow. This is a register decision: a scoreboard has no drop shadows. The tokens exist so the answer is explicit rather than improvised.

raised.$description: A raised surface is signalled by ground change plus a 2px rule, not by a shadow.

overlay.$description: Overlays are signalled by the scrim, not by a shadow.

scrim.$description: Modal/drawer scrim over the page. Never used to derive a text colour.

disabled.$description: Deliberately 1: the disabled state uses its own SOLID tokens. Fading text with opacity is how the 1.x system produced 4.39:1 body copy.

motion.$description: Near-instant by register. The page should feel mechanical, not animated. Anything that moves must be gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

instant.$description: Ground and rule changes. The default.

slow.$description: The ceiling. Anything slower is off-register.

breakpoint.$description: Min-width breakpoints, named for what actually changes at each rather than for devices.

sm.$description: The venue switcher leaves the header's first row.

focus.$description: Focus is a SLAB, not a glow - consistent with the register and with having no shadows.

rules.$description: Prohibitions that are load-bearing. Each exists because a measurement said so. Violating any of these ships an accessibility defect.

noEmberOnDark.$value: A solid ember fill on midnight is 2.35:1. On dark fields the CTA is an amber fill with midnight text (9.48:1).

noAmberOnLight.$value: Amber on white is 1.85:1. Amber is a dark-ground token only.

noScreenLightOnLight.$value: screenLight on white is 1.58:1. It exists to be bright against midnight.

noDarkOnAccentBand.$value: Nothing dark is legible on the ember band: midnight on ember is 2.35:1 and forest 1.36:1. Contrast is symmetric, so this is the SAME 2.35:1 that forbids an ember fill on midnight - the ban runs in both directions from one measurement, not two. The waitlist sits in a paper slab punched out of the band instead.

noInkOpacityForText.$value: Never derive secondary text from an opacity of the ink colour. ink/70 computes to 4.39:1 and misses AA; /60, /50 and /40 are further under. Use semantic.ink.mutedOnLight (6.87:1).

noWarningOnGreige.$value: emberMid is 3.66:1 on greige. Warning text belongs on white or paper.

noMutedOnDarkOverNavy.$value: slate on navy is 4.16:1 - under the 4.5:1 body floor. mutedOnDark is a MIDNIGHT-ground token. On navy use ink.mutedOnNavy (screenLight, 8.42:1) for muted text, or ink.onDark (paper) for body. This is the most-repeated mistake in the system: three of four design agents hit it independently, and the token contrast gate cannot see it because the tokens are correct and only the PAIRING is wrong. The build's FORBIDDEN gate now re-measures it, so the ban cannot go stale unnoticed.

hoverIsComputed.$value: The codebase brightens on hover. ember's exact darkness was chosen so its brightened form still clears 4.91:1. Do not lighten ember without recomputing the hover state.

noShadows.$value: Depth comes from rules and ground inversion. There is no shadow token because there is no shadow.

pendingImplementation.$description: True as of 2026-08-02. Resolve before calling the system complete.
pendingImplementation.archivoNotSelfHosted: font.display specifies Archivo, which is NOT yet in public/fonts. Until it is, the display face falls back to the system grotesque and the brand reads generic. Self-hosting Archivo (variable, subset to latin) and retiring Bitter is the outstanding implementation task.
pendingImplementation.bitterStillShipped: public/fonts still carries Bitter from the 1.x system. It is only needed for the wordmark and should leave the page's critical path once Archivo lands.
pendingImplementation.noBrandMark: There is still no SVG logo. The wordmark is typeset. The favicon is the RETIRED Lakeville Links emblem, so every social share previews the old brand.
pendingImplementation.noPhotography: No venue photography exists in this project. Media slots are designed reservations. Stillwater has never been photographed at all.
